blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Most preference optimization methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), apply preference supervision at the response level, although autoregressive language models are optimized token by token. As a result, all tokens in a rejected response contribute to the negative training signal, including tokens that may encode behavior that is useful for the preferred response. We introduce GAW-PO, a gradient-aligned token reweighting method for DPO that estimates, for each rejected token, whether penalizing it would interfere with the preferred update directions. Tokens whose gradients are strongly aligned with the preferred behavior receive a weaker negative contribution, while conflicting tokens retain a stronger penalty. Our method achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated preference-optimization methods, improving by 0.97 points over standard DPO and 0.65 points over the strongest competing baseline across 11 benchmarks spanning mathematics, reasoning, coding, and question answering. We further show that gradient-aligned weighting is substantially more robust to aggressive preference optimization: as the DPO regularization parameter β \beta decreases, standard DPO degrades sharply, whereas GAW-PO continues to improve. These results suggest that accounting for the interaction between rejected-token updates and preferred behavior provides an effective form of token-level credit assignment for preference optimization.
blocks.zh: 大多数偏好优化方法,如直接偏好优化(DPO),在响应层面应用偏好监管,尽管自动递减语言模型通过符号优化代号. 因此,一个被拒绝的响应中的所有符号都有助于负面的训练信号,包括可能对首选响应有用的行为编码的符号. 我们引入了GAW-PO(GAW-PO),这是DPO的一种梯度对齐的符号重置方法,它估计,对于每个被拒绝的符号,惩罚是否会干扰首选的更新方向. 其梯度与偏好行为高度吻合的托肯受到较弱的负作用,而相冲突的符号则保留较强的惩罚. 我们的方法实现了所评价的偏好优化方法中最高的平均性能,比标准的DPO提高了0.97分,比数学、推理、编码和问答等11个基准中最强的相互竞争的基准提高了0.65分。 我们进一步表明,梯度相适应的加权比积极的优惠优化要强得多:随着DPO规范化参数β \beta的减少,标准的DPO急剧下降,而GAW-PO则继续改善. 这些结果表明,对被拒绝的更新与首选行为之间的相互作用进行核算,为优化优惠提供了一种有效的象征性信用分配形式。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Preference optimization has become a standard approach for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences. Among these methods, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) is widely used due to its simplicity and effectiveness. Given a prompt, a chosen (preferred) response, and a rejected response, DPO trains the model to increase the relative preference for the chosen completion over the rejected one with respect to a reference policy. However, the supervision available to DPO is defined at the response level, while autoregressive language models operate at the token level. As a consequence, all tokens in a rejected response contribute to the optimization signal, even though only a small subset of them may be responsible for the response being considered of lesser quality.
blocks.zh: 首选优化成为了将大语言模型(LLMs)与人类偏好一致的标准方法. 在这些方法中,直接偏好优化(DPO)(Rafailov等人,2023年)因其简单和有效而得到广泛使用. 鉴于一个迅速、选择的(首选的)答复和拒绝的答复,DPO对模型进行了培训,以便在参考政策方面增加选择完成的相对偏好,而不是拒绝完成的相对偏好。 然而,DPO可用的监督是在响应层面定义的,而自递性语言模型则在象征层面运行. 因此,一个被拒绝的响应中的所有符号都有助于优化信号,即使其中只有一小部分可能对被认为质量较低的响应负责.

blocks.en: This mismatch can lead to undesirable or at least inefficient updates during preference optimization. A rejected completion is rarely incorrect in its entirety: it may contain valid facts, correct intermediate calculations, appropriate formatting, or linguistic patterns that are also useful for generating the preferred response. Nevertheless, standard DPO does not explicitly distinguish these locally correct components from the tokens that actually determine the preference. Reducing the likelihood of the rejected response can therefore also suppress behaviors that should ideally be preserved. Figure 1 illustrates a simple example of this effect. More generally, the DPO objective constrains the relative preference between the chosen and rejected completions, but does not require the absolute likelihood of the chosen response to increase. Indeed, several works have observed that the likelihood of preferred responses can decrease during DPO training even while the preference objective improves ( Pal et al., 2024 ; Pang et al., 2024 ) . This behavior suggests that the optimization dynamics of preferred and rejected responses can be strongly coupled ( Razin et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 这种不匹配可能导致在优惠优化期间出现不可取或至少低效的更新. 被拒绝的补全很少完全不正确:它可能包含有效的事实,正确的中间计算,适当的格式,或语言模式,对于生成首选的响应同样有用. 尽管如此,标准DPO并没有明确区分这些当地正确的组件与实际决定偏好的指标. 因此,减少被拒绝答复的可能性也可以抑制最好加以保留的行为。 图1说明了这种影响的简单例子。 更一般地说,DPO目标限制所选完成和被拒绝完成之间的相对偏好,但并不要求所选答复的绝对可能性增加. 事实上,有几部著作指出,在DPO培训期间,即使偏好目标有所改善,首选反应的可能性也会降低(Pal等人,2024年;Pang等人,2024年)。 这种行为表明,首选反应和拒绝反应的优化动态可以紧密结合(Razin等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Standard DPO penalizes every token of the rejected response, including the arithmetic; our method concentrates the penalty on the token that conflicts with the preferred response.
blocks.zh: 图1:标准DPO惩罚被拒绝答复的每一个符号,包括算术;我们的方法集中惩罚与首选反应相冲突的符号.

blocks.en: This limitation can be addressed by introducing finer-grained supervision at the token level. Recent methods have proposed token-level preference objectives ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) or weighting schemes ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) that avoid treating every token in a response as equally informative. These methods primarily aim to estimate how important or informative an individual token is. Existing methods alone, however, do not fully characterize the consequence of penalizing that token during optimization.
blocks.zh: 这种限制可以通过在象征性层面实行更精细的监督来解决。 最近的方法提出了象征性的偏好目标(Zeng等人,2024年)或加权计划(Liu等人,2025年;Yang等人,2026年;Li等人,2025年),避免在答复中将每个符号都视为同等信息。 这些方法主要旨在估计个人标志的重要性或信息性。 然而,仅靠现有方法并不能充分说明在优化期间惩罚这种象征的后果。

blocks.en: Conversely, we consider the effect that suppressing a rejected token would have on the model’s ability to represent the preferred response. Our starting point is the observation that training samples interact through their parameter updates. This idea has a long history in machine learning, most prominently in work on influence functions ( Koh and Liang, 2017 ) and gradient-based influence estimation ( Pruthi et al., 2020 ) . In these approaches, the relationship between training examples can be characterized by comparing the parameter updates they induce. Examples with similar gradient directions tend to modify the model in compatible ways, while opposing gradients indicate conflicting training signals. Related ideas have also been applied to LLMs, for example for selecting instruction-tuning or reasoning data based on gradient similarity ( Xia et al., 2024 ; Jung et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 相反,我们认为,压制一个被拒绝的标志会对模型代表首选反应的能力产生影响。 我们的起点是观察 训练样本通过参数更新相互作用 这个想法在机器学习方面有着悠久的历史,最突出的是影响函数(Koh and Liang,2017)和梯度影响估计(Pruti等人,2020年). 在这些方法中,培训实例之间的关系的特点可以是比较它们引发的参数更新。 具有类似梯度方向的例子往往以兼容的方式修改模型,而对立的梯度则表明训练信号相互冲突. 对LLMs也应用了相关的想法,例如根据梯度相似性选择指令调制或推理数据(Xia等人,2024年;Jung等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
We apply this perspective to token-level preference optimization. Rather than assigning a weight to a rejected token based only on its probability, loss, or gradient magnitude, we investigate how the update induced by penalizing that token interacts with the update supported by the preferred response. If a rejected token induces a parameter update that is strongly aligned with the one associated with the preferred completion, suppressing that token is likely to interfere with behavior that is also useful for modeling the preferred response. Such a token should therefore receive a weaker negative signal. Conversely, if the token induces an update that is dissimilar to, or conflicts with, the preferred-response update, penalizing it is less likely to damage the behavior encouraged by the chosen completion and can therefore receive a stronger negative signal.
Based on this principle, we introduce GAW-PO, a gradient-aligned token reweighting method for DPO that explicitly accounts for interference between rejected-token updates and preferred update directions.
blocks.zh:
我们用这个视角来优化符号级的偏好。 我们不是仅仅根据其概率、损失或梯度大小来给一个被拒绝的代号分配权重,而是调查通过惩罚该代号而导致的更新如何与首选响应所支持的更新相互作用。 如果一个被拒绝的令牌会诱导一个参数更新,而该参数的更新与首选的完成相关联,压制该令牌很可能会干扰同样对建模首选的响应有用的行为. 因此,这种标志应获得较弱的负面信号。 相反,如果信使诱导的更新与首选响应更新不同,或与之冲突,则惩罚它不太可能损害被选择的完成所鼓励的行为,因此可以收到更强烈的负面信号.
基于这一原则,我们引入了GAW-PO,这是DPO的一种梯度对齐的符号重新加权方法,它明确说明拒绝的更新和首选更新方向之间的干扰.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: (1) We propose a gradient-aligned token weighting objective for DPO that selectively downweights rejected tokens whose penalization would interfere with behavior supported by preferred responses. (2) We show that our formulation improves average downstream performance over standard DPO and competing methods, while remaining stable under substantially more aggressive optimization regimes in which standard DPO degrades sharply. We open-source our implementation, gradient-weight computation pipeline, training recipes, filtered preference data, and evaluation setup to facilitate reproducibility and further study: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Weighted-DPO-Supplementary-8441/
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: (1) 我们为DPO提出一个梯度一致的标志性加权目标,有选择地降低重量,拒绝惩罚会干扰得到首选反应支持的行为的标志。 (2) 我们的表述表明,与标准的DPO和相互竞争的方法相比,我们的表述提高了下游的平均业绩,同时在更积极的优化制度下保持稳定,在这种制度下,标准的DPO急剧下降。 我们开源执行、梯度加权计算管道、培训秘方、过滤的偏好数据以及便于复制的评价设置和进一步研究:https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Weighted-DPO-substary-8441/

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Preference optimization. DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) replaced the reward model and reinforcement learning stage of RLHF ( Christiano et al., 2017 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ) with a single classification loss on preference pairs. Most of its variants keep the entire response as the unit of optimization: IPO ( Azar et al., 2024 ) changes the loss to limit overfitting, KTO ( Ethayarajh et al., 2024 ) learns from unpaired feedback, and SimPO ( Meng et al., 2024b ) replaces the reference model with a length-normalized reward. A known side effect of this response-level objective is that the likelihood of the chosen response can decrease during training, in particular when the two responses differ in only a few tokens ( Pal et al., 2024 ; Pang et al., 2024 ; Razin et al., 2025 ) . The previously proposed solutions also act on whole responses, either by adding a likelihood term on the chosen response ( Pal et al., 2024 ; Pang et al., 2024 ) or by filtering out pairs with similar representations ( Razin et al., 2025 ) . Our method keeps every pair and changes only how strongly each rejected token is penalized.
blocks.zh: 优待优化. DPO(Rafailov等人,2023年)取代了RLHF的奖励模式和强化学习阶段(Christiano等人,2017年;Ouyang等人,2022年),在首选配对上采用单一的分类损失. 其大多数变体保留了整个响应作为优化的单位:IPO(Azar等人,2024年)改变损失以限制过度配色,KTO(Ethayarajh等人,2024年)学习未发的反馈,SimPO(Meng等人,2024年b)以长度正常的奖励取代参考模型. 这一响应层面目标的一个已知副作用是,在培训期间,所选择的响应的可能性可能会降低,特别是在两个响应仅在几个符号上有所不同的情况下(Pal等人,2024年;Pang等人,2024年;Razin等人,2025年)。 先前提出的解决方案也对整个应对措施采取行动,要么在选定的应对措施上添加一个可能性术语(Pal等人,2024年;Pang等人,2024年),要么过滤出具有类似表述的对子(Razin等人,2025年)。 我们的方法保持每对 并且只改变 多么强烈的每个被拒绝的标志 受到惩罚。

blocks.en: Token- and step-level credit assignment. Finer-grained methods differ mainly in the source of the token-level signal. TDPO ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) rewrites the Bradley–Terry objective in terms of token-level advantages but still weights all tokens equally, while TIS-DPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) takes token weights from the probability gap between two contrastive LLMs, which have to be obtained by prompting or trained separately. For reasoning, Step-DPO ( Lai et al., 2024 ) moves from tokens to steps: it finds the first incorrect step of a wrong solution and contrasts a correct and an incorrect continuation of the same correct prefix. This leaves the shared steps unpenalized, but requires locating the error, manually or using a strong LLM judge, and resampling continuations. Similar to our approach, TI-DPO ( Yang et al., 2026 ) also relies on gradients, but computes them with respect to the input embeddings and weights each token by the gradient norm, which measures how strongly the output depends on the token and not whether penalizing it would work against the chosen response.
blocks.zh: 托肯和继位信用分配。 细纹方法主要在符号级信号的来源上有所不同. TDPO(Zeng等人,2024年)在象征级优势方面改写了Bradley–Terry目标,但仍然平等地权衡所有象征物,而TIS-DPO(Liu等人,2025年)则从两个对比性LLMs之间的概率差距中取得象征性的权重,这必须分别通过催化或训练获得. 为了推理,Step-DPO(Lai et al.,2024)从符符移到阶:它发现错误解决方案的第一个不正确的步骤,并对比同一正确前缀的正确和不正确的延续. 这使得共享步骤不被处罚,但需要手动或使用强大的LLM判断器来定位错误,并重印续作. 与我们的方法相似,TI-DPO(Yang等人,2026年)也依赖梯度,但用梯度规范计算每个符的输入嵌入和权重,该规范衡量输出对符的依赖程度,而不是惩罚是否与选定的响应相悖.

blocks.en: AAO ( Li et al., 2025 ) is motivated by the same problem as our method: DPO pushes the same content up in the chosen response and down in the rejected one. It compares each token with the tokens of the other response using the model’s input embeddings, and assigns lower weights to tokens that have a close match. However, input embeddings ignore context, so a rejected token is treated as shared whenever the same token appears anywhere in the chosen response. In Figure 1 , this includes the incorrect operand “2”, which also appears as the first operand of the chosen response.
blocks.zh: AAO(Li等人,2025年)的动机与我们的方法相同: DPO在选择的响应中将相同的内容推向上,在被拒绝的响应中将相同的内容推向下. 它使用模型的输入嵌入物将每个令牌与其它响应的令牌进行比较,并将较低的权重分配给有近吻合的令牌. 然而,输入嵌入忽略了上下文,所以当所选择的响应中任何地方出现同一符号时,一个被拒绝的符号就被当作共享. 在图1中,这包括不正确的“2”字,它也作为所选答复的第一个字。

blocks.en:
Gradient interaction between training signals. GAW-PO measures the interaction between rejected-token and chosen-response updates directly. Following the use of gradient inner products to relate training examples in influence estimation and data selection ( Koh and Liang, 2017 ; Pruthi et al., 2020 ; Xia et al., 2024 ) , we score each rejected token by the inner product between its parameter gradient and the gradients of chosen responses, from its own pair and averaged over the training dataset. Unlike the TI-DPO and AAO scores, this score is signed and depends on response context, and it is computed once before training without an auxiliary model. The closest work in terms of intent is NTHR ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , which reduces the penalty on tokens of incorrect responses in GRPO by approximating their gradient interactions through hidden-state and prediction-error alignment.
Most token-level methods above were evaluated on dialogue, safety or summarization with LLM judges, or on a single domain, while we evaluate on 11 benchmarks across mathematics, reasoning, code, and question answering.
blocks.zh:
训练信号之间的渐变交互. GAW-PO直接衡量拒绝键和选择的响应更新之间的相互作用。 使用梯度内产物将影响估计和数据选择的培训实例联系起来(Koh和Liang, 2017;Pruti等人, 2020;Xia等人, 2024)之后,我们从自己的对数中,并在培训数据集的平均值中,用其参数梯度和所选答复梯度之间的内产物对每个被否定的符号进行评分。 与TI-DPO和AAO的分数不同,这个分数是签名的,取决于响应上下文,在训练前一次计算,没有辅助模型. 在意图方面最接近的作品是NTHR(Deng et al., 2026),它通过通过隐藏状态和预测-error对齐来近似其梯度相互作用,从而减轻了对GRPO中不正确响应的信号的处罚.
以上大多数象征性方法都是在与LLM法官的对话、安全或总结上或在一个单一领域进行评估的,而我们则在数学、推理、代码和回答问题的11个基准上进行评估。

blocks.zh: 3.2 基于渐变的托肯重量

blocks.en: This choice reflects two complementary notions of interference. A rejected token receives a weaker penalty if suppressing it would conflict either with its paired chosen response or with behavior that is consistently supported by chosen responses across the dataset. If the resulting similarity is high, the rejected token and at least one of the chosen signals induce similar parameter updates. Penalizing that token would therefore move the model in the opposite direction and may interfere with preferred behavior, so we assign it a smaller weight. Conversely, when the rejected-token gradient is dissimilar to both its paired chosen gradient and the aggregate chosen gradient, suppressing the token is less likely to interfere with preferred behavior, and it receives a larger loss weight.
blocks.zh: 这一选择反映了两个互补的干预概念。 如果一个被拒绝的令牌与其配对的选定答复或与整个数据集的选定答复一致支持的行为相冲突,则其惩罚就会更轻。 如果由此产生的相似度很高,则被拒绝的令牌和至少一个选定的信号会诱导类似的参数更新. 惩罚这个标志会把模型移向相反的方向,并可能干扰偏好的行为,所以我们给它分配一个较小的重量. 反之,当拒绝键梯度与其配对的选定梯度和总和的选定梯度相异时,压制令牌不太可能干扰偏好的行为,得到更大的减重.

blocks.en: Computing a separate token gradient over all model parameters is prohibitively expensive for modern LLMs. We therefore measure gradient alignment in the parameter space of a rank-64 PiSSA-initialized adapter ( Meng et al., 2024a ) attached to the frozen base model. The adapter is used only as a gradient probe ; the subsequent DPO stage performs full-model fine-tuning. Because PiSSA initializes the low-rank factors from the principal singular components of each weight matrix, the adapter gradients are projections of the full-parameter gradients onto these principal subspaces (see Appendix A.2 ). A property reported by Meng et al. (2024a) motivates this choice: the training loss and gradient-norm trajectories of PiSSA follow those of full-parameter fine-tuning closely, and do so consistently across ranks from 1 1 to 128 128 on several models. This indicates that gradients restricted to the principal subspaces preserve most of the full-parameter gradient signal.

blocks.en: We use Olmo-3-7B-Instruct-SFT 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Instruct-SFT , the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) checkpoint of the 7B OLMo 3 Instruct model ( Olmo et al., 2025 ) , as the initialization for all experiments. blocks.en: 5.1 Comparison with Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 5.1 与现行方法的比较

blocks.en: Table 1 compares GAW-PO against standard DPO and existing preference-optimization and token-weighting approaches using the experimental setup from Section 4 . Our method achieves the strongest overall performance, with an average score of 41.99 . This corresponds to an absolute improvement of 0.97 points over standard DPO (41.02) and 0.65 points over TIS-DPO (41.34), the strongest competing method on average. Moreover, the gains are distributed across several capability groups; GAW-PO obtains the best result on 8 of the 11 evaluated benchmarks.

blocks.en: The largest improvements are observed on reasoning and coding tasks. On BBH, our method reaches 49.81 , improving over standard DPO by 4.36 points and over the strongest competing baseline by 4.31 points. Similarly, on LiveCodeBench, we obtain 24.78 , compared with 21.36 for DPO and 21.88 for TIS-DPO. We also observe consistent gains on HumanEval+ (73.52), MATH (70.35), AGI Eval (61.15), MBPP+ (57.73), and MMLU (67.92). These results indicate that reducing harmful rejected-token updates can improve performance across different downstream tasks. Appendix D.1 shows that the weights fall on the tokens where a rejected response diverges from the chosen one, sparing correct content.
blocks.zh: 在推理和编码任务方面观察到的最大改进。 在BBH方面,我们的方法达到了49.81,比标准的DPO提高了4.36分,比最强的相互竞争基线提高了4.31分。 同样,在LiveCode Bench上,我们获得24.78,而DPO为21.36,TIS-DPO为21.88。 我们还看到在HumanEval+(73.52)、MATH(70.35)、AGI Eval(61.15)、MBPP+(57.73)和MMLU(67.92)方面不断取得进展。 这些结果表明,减少有害的拒绝更新可以改善不同下游任务的绩效。 附录D.1显示,如果被拒绝的答复与所选答复不同,则其权重落在标志上,从而省去了正确的内容。

blocks.en: The improvement is not universal across all benchmarks. TIS-DPO performs best on AIME 2025 and GPQA, while IPO obtains the highest score on Omega 500. In particular, our method underperforms on GPQA and Omega 500. Nevertheless, the stronger performance across the majority of benchmarks results in the highest aggregate score among all evaluated methods.
blocks.zh: 并非所有基准的改进都具有普遍性。 TIS-DPO在AIME 2025和GPQA上表现最好,而IPO在Omega 500上获得最高分. 尤其是我们的方法在GPQA和Omega 500上表现不佳. 然而,大多数基准的绩效越强,所有评价方法的总分就越高。

blocks.en: Overall, these results support our hypothesis that token weights should depend on their interaction with preferred update directions , rather than only on token-level importance in isolation. By downweighting rejected tokens whose gradients are compatible with preferred behavior and concentrating the negative signal on conflicting updates, our method produces a more targeted preference-optimization signal and improves overall downstream performance.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果支持我们的假设,即象征性的权重应该取决于它们与首选更新方向的互动,而不只是孤立地依赖于象征性的重要性。 通过将梯度与偏好行为相适应的被否决的标志降压,并将负面信号集中到相互矛盾的更新上,我们的方法产生了更有针对性的偏好优化信号,提高了下游的整体性能.

blocks.en: 5.2 Robustness to the DPO Regularization Strength
blocks.zh: 5.2 对DPO正规化的强项

blocks.en: The DPO parameter β \beta (see Equation 1 ) controls the strength of the implicit regularization toward the reference policy. Larger values constrain the optimized policy more strongly, whereas smaller values permit larger deviations from the reference model. In practice, DPO is commonly trained with moderate values of β ≈ 0.1 \beta\approx 0.1 , since aggressive preference optimization can lead to substantial degradation due to policy collapse. Under our motivating hypothesis, part of this degradation may arise because stronger optimization also amplifies the penalty applied to locally correct tokens in rejected responses, suppressing both useful behavior and genuinely undesirable parts of the response.

In contrast, our method remains stable over the entire sweep and improves as the regularization is relaxed. At the most aggressive setting, standard DPO loses almost all of its performance, whereas GAW-PO achieves its best aggregate result. Notably, GAW-PO at β = 0.002 \beta=0.002 also surpasses the best standard-DPO configuration observed anywhere in the sweep. The category-level results detailed in Appendix E.1 reveal the same pattern across mathematics, reasoning, coding, and QA.

blocks.en: These results indicate that our weighting scheme substantially enlarges the range of β \beta values over which preference optimization remains effective. Standard DPO requires relatively strong regularization to prevent destructive updates, resulting in a narrow range of effective optimization strengths. By reducing the contribution of rejected tokens whose gradients are aligned with preferred behavior, GAW-PO permits substantially larger deviations from the reference policy without loss in downstream capability. This is consistent with our hypothesis that part of the instability of aggressive DPO originates from negative updates applied to behavior that should be preserved. Random or uniform weights with the same mean lose relative to gradient-aligned weights, so the gain is not due to reduced penalty magnitude alone (see Appendix D.2 ).
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,我们的加权办法大大扩大了β \β值的范围,对于这些数值,优化优惠仍然有效。 标准DPO要求相对强大的规范化以防止破坏性更新,导致有效优化优势范围狭窄. GAW-PO通过减少其梯度与偏好行为相一致的被拒绝的代币的贡献,允许在不丧失下游能力的情况下大幅偏离参考政策。 这符合我们的假设,即侵略性的DPO的不稳定部分来源于应用在应该保存的行为上的负面更新. 与梯度对齐的权重相比,相同平均值的随机或统一权重会损失,因此增益并非仅仅由于处罚幅度的降低(见附录D.2).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We introduced a gradient-aligned token reweighting approach for DPO that accounts for the effect of penalizing individual rejected tokens on preferred behavior. Rather than estimating token importance in isolation, GAW-PO compares rejected-token gradients with preferred update directions and reduces the penalty on tokens whose suppression would interfere with learning the chosen response. We make this computation practical through a low-rank PiSSA gradient probe, while retaining full-model preference optimization during training.
blocks.zh: 我们为DPO引入了一种梯度相适应的符号重置方法,它说明了惩罚个人被拒绝的符号对偏好行为的影响. GAW-PO没有孤立地估计象征性的重要性,而是将被拒绝的梯度与首选的更新方向进行比较,并减轻对抑制会干扰学习所选择的响应的标志的惩罚。 我们通过一个低级的 PISSA 梯度探测器使这个计算实用,同时在训练期间保留完整的模型优化偏好.

blocks.en: Across our evaluation suite, the proposed method achieves the highest average performance among the considered preference-optimization methods, outperforming standard DPO and the strongest competing baseline. More importantly, the method remains effective under substantially more aggressive preference optimization: as β \beta decreases, standard DPO degrades sharply, whereas GAW-PO remained stable and often improved. We additionally explored representing preferred behavior through multiple clustered update directions. While this provides modest gains for some values of K K , the results also showed that increasing the number of preferred directions is not sufficient by itself; the structure and quality of these directions are also important.
blocks.zh: 在整个评价套间中,拟议方法在经过考虑的偏好优化方法、业绩优于标准的DPO和最强的相互竞争的基准中取得了最高的平均业绩。 更重要的是,这种方法在大幅度加强优惠优化的情况下依然有效:随着β\β的减少,标准的DPO急剧下降,而GAW-PO则保持稳定,而且往往有所改善。 我们通过多个集群更新方向,进一步探索代表首选行为. 虽然这为KK的某些数值提供了微小的收益,但结果也表明,增加首选方向的数量本身并不足够;这些方向的结构和质量也很重要。

blocks.en: In terms of future work, we plan to extend our method beyond pairwise objectives such as DPO to online reinforcement-learning methods, particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Although GRPO assigns updates based on relative rewards across multiple sampled responses, low-reward trajectories may still contain useful tokens or reasoning steps that are also supported by higher-reward responses. Our gradient-alignment framework could provide token-level credit assignment by downweighting negative token updates whose gradients align with high-advantage responses, while preserving stronger penalties for conflicting tokens.
blocks.zh: 在今后的工作方面,我们计划将我们的方法扩大到超越双重目标,如DPO, 特别是集团相对政策优化(GPRO)(Shao等人,2024年)。 尽管GRPO根据多个抽样答复的相对回报来分配更新,但低回报轨迹仍然可能包含也有较高回报答复支持的有用符号或推理步骤. 我们的梯度调整框架可以提供象征性的信用分配,办法是减少负式符号的加权,其梯度与高度有利反应相一致,同时对相互冲突的符号保持更严厉的惩罚。

blocks.en: Finally, Appendix F discusses the study’s limitations, from the cost of the offline weight computation to the scope of our evaluation, each pointing to a direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 最后,附录 F讨论了研究的局限性,从离线加权计算的成本到我们评价的范围,每一点都指明了未来工作的方向。

blocks.en: The results reinforce the conclusion that additional preferred directions provide only modest gains over the single dataset-level mean. K = 4 K=4 obtains the strongest aggregate score, while K = 8 K=8 is close behind and K = 2 K=2 performs worse. No value of K K dominates across all benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 这些结果加强了以下结论,即其他偏好方向仅比单一数据集的平均值略有增加。 K=4 K=4获得最强的总分,而K=8 K=8则落后,K=2 K=2表现更差. 在所有基准中,K K 值没有占据主导地位。

blocks.en: To understand this, we further measure which component attains the maximum alignment for each rejected token. In the original formulation, the paired chosen direction dominates for 79.16 % 79.16\% of tokens, while the dataset mean dominates for 20.84 % 20.84\% . With K = 2 K=2 , K = 4 K=4 , and K = 8 K=8 , the paired direction dominates for 66.69 % 66.69\% , 62.52 % 62.52\% , and 53.18 % 53.18\% of tokens, respectively, meaning that cluster-level directions determine the score for up to 46.82 % 46.82\% of rejected tokens.
blocks.zh: 为了理解这一点,我们进一步衡量哪个部分达到每个被拒绝的标志的最大一致。 在最初的配方中,配对选择的方向占79.16%的79.16\%,而数据集的平均值占20.84%的20.84%。 由于K=2K=2,K=4K=4,K=8K=8,对等方向分别占66.69% 66.69\%,62.52% 62.52\%,53.18% 53.18\%,这意味着集群级方向决定被否决的标志的得分最高为46.82% 46.82\%.

blocks.en: This shows that the clustered directions are actively used and capture preferred update directions not represented by the paired response alone. However, greater cluster utilization does not directly imply better downstream performance: K = 8 K=8 uses clustered directions most frequently but performs slightly below K = 4 K=4 , while K = 2 K=2 underperforms the original formulation. Simply increasing the number of reference directions therefore does not monotonically improve the quality of the token weights; the quality of the preferred-direction decomposition matters more than the number of available directions.
blocks.zh: 这表明分组式方向被积极使用,并捕捉单对响应不能代表的首选更新方向. 然而,集群利用率的提高并不直接意味着下游性能的更好:K=8K=8使用集群方向的频率最高,但表现略低于K=4K=4,而K=2K=2则表现不佳。 因此,仅仅增加参考方向的数量并不能单调地提高符号权重的质量;首选方向分解的质量比现有方向的数量更重要。

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制

blocks.en: Our method adds an offline stage that computes rejected-token weights before training. This stage is performed once per dataset and probe and is reused across all training runs; in our experiments it costs roughly 1.5 training runs. The cost is incurred once and is amortized across all subsequent training runs, hyperparameter sweeps, and ablations, as in our experiments. However, it is less lightweight than standard DPO for a single run.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法增加了一个离线舞台,在训练前计算出被拒绝的重量。 这个阶段是每个数据集和探测器进行一次,并在所有训练中重复使用;在我们试验中,大约需要1.5次训练。 费用是一次性的,并分期摊还到所有随后的培训、超参数扫描和堆积,就像我们的实验一样。 然而,单场比赛的重量低于标准的DPO.

blocks.en: Gradient alignment is measured in the parameter space of a low-rank PiSSA probe, which we use as a tractable proxy for the full parameter space. The choice is motivated by the relation between PiSSA gradients and full-parameter gradients, and the downstream results indicate that the resulting weights are informative. A systematic study of how the probe rank affects the weights, and of how closely low-rank alignment tracks full-parameter alignment, is left for future work.
blocks.zh: 梯度对齐是在低档PISSA探测器的参数空间中测量的,我们用它作为全参数空间的可牵引代用. 选择的动机是PISSA梯度和全参数梯度之间的关系,下游的结果表明所产生的权重是翔实的. 对探测器排名如何影响权重以及低级对齐轨道全参数对齐的系统研究,留待未来工作进行.

blocks.en: The weights are computed from the SFT initialization and kept fixed during training. This matches the offline nature of DPO, where the preference pairs do not change, but the policy’s gradient geometry does evolve over training. Estimating the weights dynamically is an extension and is required for the online setting discussed in Section 6 .
blocks.zh: 权重是从SFT初始化中计算出来的,并在培训期间保持不变。 这与DPO的离线性质相匹配,在DPO中,喜好对对不改变,但政策的梯度几何学的确比训练演化. 动态估计权重是扩展的,是第6节讨论的在线设置所需要的。

blocks.en: The conversion of alignment scores into weights has more possible choices. Alternative mappings are a promising direction, including temperature or offset parameters in the sigmoid, normalized reference directions, and rank- or quantile-based mappings.
blocks.zh: 将对齐分数转换为权重,有更大的可能选择. 备选制图是一个有希望的方向,包括西格莫德的温度或抵消参数、正常的参考方向以及等级或四位数制图。

blocks.en: Finally, our evaluation focuses on a single open model family and preference dataset, chosen to allow a controlled study, and on verifiable benchmarks in mathematics, reasoning, code, and question answering. We did not evaluate on judge-based open-ended benchmarks or on multi-turn and multilingual preference data, and extending the analysis to these settings and to larger models is an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的评价集中在一个单一的开放模式的家族和偏好数据集上,它被选择来允许一个可控的研究,以及数学、推理、代码和问答方面可核查的基准。 我们没有评估基于法官的不限成员名额基准或多回合和多语种偏好数据,将分析扩大到这些环境和更大的模式是今后工作的一个重要方向。
